title: Business School
one_paragraph_synopsis: In "Business School," Michael is honored as a visiting professor and guest speaker in Ryan's Emerging Enterprises class, where he delivers an unconventional and passionate lecture on business and life. Meanwhile, Pam rekindles her relationship with Roy and prepares for her art show, which Michael proudly supports. The office is thrown into chaos by a loose bat, leading to strange effects on Jim. Michael faces skepticism and challenging questions from the business students, culminating in a tense confrontation and his decision to move Ryan to the annex rather than fire him. The episode also features social experiments, office jokes, and subtle interpersonal tensions, including Karen's secret removal of Pam's art show flyer.
